meta.name: product-strategy-session
meta.description: Run an end-to-end product strategy session across positioning, discovery, and roadmap planning. Use when a team needs validated direction before committing to execution.

copy.tagline: 规划产品定位、发现与路线图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队需要验证方向后再投入执行
copy.tagline_en: Run a full product strategy session from positioning to roadmap
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs validated direction before committing to execution

howto.what: 引导你完成产品战略的完整流程：从市场定位、问题发现、方案探索到路线图规划，最终输出验证过的战略方向和可执行的优先级路线图。
howto.when: 当团队需要为新产品、重大举措或现有产品重新定位制定战略方向时触发。通常用于季度/年度规划或新领导入职。

say.text: 为我们的数据分析插件运行一次战略会议，采用率低，两个路线图方案冲突。
帮我做一次产品战略会议，目标是新用户增长。
say.note: Claude 会从定位开始，逐步引导你完成各阶段。

howto.what_en: Guides you through a complete product strategy process: from market positioning, problem discovery, solution exploration to roadmap planning, resulting in a validated strategic direction and prioritized executable roadmap.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a team needs strategic direction for a new product, major initiative, or repositioning an existing product. Typically used for quarterly/annual planning or onboarding new product leaders.

say_en.text: Run a strategy session for our analytics add-on: flat adoption, two competing roadmap visions.
Help me run a product strategy session focused on new user growth.
say_en.note: Claude will start from positioning and guide you step by step.
